jobs.title: Curriculum Manager - AI Engineering
jobs.description: About DataCamp Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors. In this role, you'll combine AI skills, technical expertise, and passion for great didactic experiences to usher in the next generation of education . About the role This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with subject matter experts and leverage in-house-built cutting-edge AI tooling to scale high-quality course creation across AI engineering: building applications with large language models (LLMs), prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and related topics such as evaluation, fine-tuning, guardrails, and LLMOps. Here's what your day-to-day will look like: Manage the entire content development lifecycle and deadlines. Source and recruit top-tier subject-matter experts as instructors. Collaborate with instructors to create engaging content. Consistently leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and more to drive high-quality content production at scale. Design, review, and create content on LLM application development, prompt and context engineering, RAG and vector databases, agents and tool use, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of AI systems, and related topics. You will review content from a learner perspective, ensuring it is technically accurate, reflects current AI engineering best practices in a fast-moving field, and is pedagogically effective. Continuously assess course performance using learner feedback and engagement data to drive improvements. Identify and prioritize existing curriculum gaps or new topics in DataCamp's AI engineering curriculum. jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.

jobs.description: We are looking for a skilled Personal Trainer to help clients improve flexibility, mobility, and functional movement. You will design and guide personalized programs, monitor progress, and collaborate with our wellness team to ensure the best outcomes. What You’ll Do : Assess clients’ mobility, flexibility, and movement patterns. Design and implement customized stretching and mobility programs. Guide clients through safe and effective exercises. Monitor progress and adjust programs as needed. Maintain detailed client records. Collaborate with the healthcare/wellness team for integrated care. Conduct yoga or group classes as needed.
